passed: One20s readiness deadline and independent20s result watchdog,10s cleanup wait are implemented without extending readiness.
Normal two-ready release does not immediately cancel; failure paths release/cancel.
Worker-tagged terminal channel has capacity2 and exactly one send per worker, allowing late worker send after parent exit.
Barrier is closed in mutually exclusive branches; readiness and terminal IDs are deduplicated.
Early terminal results are retained, not dropped during ready wait.
No production startup/SQLite parameters changed; unknown original root cause retained.
limitations: This review concerns fixture reliability and diagnostic evidence, not a newly proven production startup defect.

closed_blockers.finding: Function defer removes directory before testing.T.Cleanup closes the reopened pool. On Windows this reintroduces open-file deletion failure; RemoveAll error is ignored.
closed_blockers.fix: Make reopened-pool close precede directory removal in one ordered cleanup path, including assertion failures. Record close/remove failures instead of silently treating cleanup as successful.

closed_blockers.finding: Worker cleanup only runs in nil-error successful-open branch. Non-nil DB plus error is not closed, yet empty closeCode allows allPoolsClosed=true. Pool ownership is not universally enforced.
closed_blockers.fix: Independently register cleanup for every nonnil DB before branching on openErr/validation; publish terminal result only after cleanup outcome is known. Close error must prevent directory deletion.

closed_blockers.finding: Worker complete-schema validation is only COUNT>0. Reopen comparison counts two enumerations of the same database, so mutually consistent partial schema can pass. Approved contract requires complete expected schema, not merely nonempty/self-consistent objects.
closed_blockers.fix: Validate winner and reopened database against a known full schema inventory or isolated canonical baseline including tables/indexes/triggers/constraints; worker must return pure structured verification result without testing API. Preserve independent-pool and exactly-one-success/conflict assertions.

followup_verified: Worker defer handles every nonnil returned DB and sends terminal result only after close outcome.
readSchemaSnapshot has no testing API; winner and reopened DB compare complete normalized sqlite_master inventory to separate AutoMigrate+revision-trigger+unique-index reference.
Reopen pool closed synchronously before directory-removal defer.
Cleanup-incomplete path copies stage slices under mutex and reports stages; stage durations present.
Ready/result failure returns after cleanup instead of entering success validation.
nonblocking_note: Previously suggested nonnil+error cleanup is now implemented for expected-schema and reopen pools.
execution: Static review complete, zero remaining blockers/required changes. Parent may dispatch targeted validation under approved window. No tests/build/service execution performed by reviewer; original race root cause remains unknown until new evidence.

closed_adjustments.finding: appendStage still has no explicit cap although approved design requires bounded per-worker summaries.
closed_adjustments.fix: Use fixed per-worker maximum (e.g.64) and fixed overflow flag, maintaining mutex protection.

closed_adjustments.finding: Directory RemoveAll failure remains silently ignored; successful pool close does not guarantee filesystem removal.
closed_adjustments.fix: Report fixed cleanup_remove_failed from parent cleanup, preserve retained directory on failure without logging raw paths/SQL.

final_followup_verified: Per-worker stage summaries cap64 with mutex-protected overflow flag included in failure diagnostics.
RemoveAll failure reports fixed cleanup_remove_failed without path or raw error.
Expected schema helper closes available pool even if connector returns nonnil DB plus error.
Reopen closes any nonnil DB before final assertions and directory cleanup, independent of Open error.
